feedback.seven-shifts-assigning-employee: I don't like that this is assuming that all workers have shifts. It is a good design though. I will keep it for detailed review.
feedback.square-shift-scheduling: I like the calendar view but not the fact that I have to choose every shift and create this for every week. In the case I'm creating this is something that will keep on going forever. I also like the "Add shift" modal.
feedback.employment-hero-clashes: Not interested in seeing clashes. It doesn't apply to our specific functionality.
feedback.seven-shifts-assignment-matrix: This is a good example of a way to relate people to operations and to roles. not exactly to machines or work orders.
feedback.zoho-audit-log: not what I'm looking for at all.
feedback.seven-shifts-moving-role: I have too many workers in the plant. This design would be extremely long. This is not the way I would like to manage it. I would like to have groups of workers sharing a shift and groups of workers sharing an operation. I could add these groups to a table designed like this. But not each worker.
feedback.deputy-custom-shifts: This left side bar with worker names could also have worker groups. I like that. I could also plan weeks ahead in a simple to use calendar view. I also like the modal to add specific shift data and the repeat pattern functionality.
feedback.deputy-schedule-template: This looks very interesting from the point of view I can build patterns, assign them to a large group and the way to schedule those templates. I don't really understand how this works so I would like some clarification to see how I can better use it. One thing I don't like is that there's too much information in the screen and it doesn't look easy to use. I would like a simpler solution.
feedback.seven-shifts-location-role-coverage: I don't really understand what this is or how this solves the problem I'm trying to solve. You should suggests things that solves the specific problem stated in the docs.

assignment-scopes-2026-07-23.title: Assignment scopes and recurring worker schedules
assignment-scopes-2026-07-23.note: Investigate four scopes: work-order or machine operators identified by QR scan at work-order start; operation-and-shift workers whose active shift may come from sign-in data; operation-wide leaders assigned across all shifts; and factory or multi-operation leaders. Also investigate reusable worker groups with recurring schedules that repeat on selected weekdays indefinitely or until an end date, inspired by calendar recurrence controls. Test how scope precedence, evidence traceability, temporary replacements, and group schedules work together.
